_comment: Copy to n8n_nodes/port_config.json (gitignored) and fill in. ORACLE_MCP_URL / ORACLE_MCP_TOKEN in the environment override the file, so a build can run without a token on disk. oracleToken is the same Keycloak bearer token the flow's other Oracle nodes use; it expires, and node 21 then fails loudly.
_comment_models: fixture mode sends fixtureModels as versions.models so the run reproduces the engine sha bit-for-bit; live mode records the flow's OCR model
_comment_secret: never commit port_config.json: it holds a live bearer token
